run_leak_checker_test: run the LeakCheckerTest to check Haiku modules for JAX tracer leaks
test_haiku_module_transform: test a Haiku module using hk.transform_with_state with init and apply
enable_jax_tracer_leak_check: enable JAX tracer leak checking by setting jax_check_tracer_leaks config to True
get_module_cls_from_fn: get a Haiku module class from a module function using get_module_cls
eval_shape_on_module: use jax.eval_shape to evaluate the output shape of a Haiku module function
